Course codes, titles, units, term placement, and major/GE/elective categories transcribed verbatim from the published term grids. Area ... course") follow the published option lists; the mapper recommends meeting with a counselor for GE selection. The pathway flags some courses as having prerequisites, but the mapper's published prerequisite text is internally inconsistent (e.g., the Beginning Piano I course page lists Nursing courses as prerequisites; the General Chemistry I page lists a duplicated entry), so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official El Camino College catalog course descriptions for prerequisites.
